image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent T-Rex from the config library at the starting line. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Forest-green pebbled skin, charcoal spine plates, sulfur-yellow underbelly, two-fingered tiny hands. ACTION: He is standing tall and imposing at the start, filling the entire width of his racing lane. His massive legs are braced wide. His tiny two-fingered hands are folded. FACIAL EXPRESSION: A fierce, grumpy scowl with his upper teeth slightly overlapping his lower lip. He is staring sideways at the other racers with a menacing 'I'm the boss' look. SETTING: The prehistoric starting line. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3' with chunky, powerful proportions. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' front-three-quarter view to show off his massive head and jaw.
